comments.headline: Conflicting open space area calculations across sheets
comments.summary: Three different open space totals appear in plan documents (4,710 SF, 4,960 SF, 5,859 SF), and site area calculations also vary, preventing verification of compliance with the 5% minimum requirement.
comments.attn: Verify controlling site area against legal description and survey; reconcile all area calculations and percentages across sheets.

details.text: Three conflicting open space totals: Site Data Table 4,710 SF, Site Plan drawing 4,960 SF, Landscape Calculations 5,855 SF. Site area basis also conflicts (94,192 SF vs 94,293 SF), preventing minimum 5% verification.

runComments.comment: Three conflicting open space area figures exist: Site Data Table shows 4,710 SF provided (vs. 4,709.62 SF required), Site Plan drawing shows 4,960 SF, and Landscape Calculations show 5,859 SF provided (vs. 4,715 SF required based on 94,293 SF site area). Additionally, site area basis differs (94,192 SF vs 94,293 SF). Cannot determine if minimum 5% requirement is met. Reconcile calculations across all sheets.

details.text: Site area basis differs 101 SF between sheets (94,192 SF on Sheet 9 vs 94,293 SF on Sheet 35), affecting required open space calculation (4,709.62 SF vs 4,715 SF required).

runComments.comment: Site area basis varies across documents: Sheet 9 uses 94,192 SF; Sheet 35 uses 94,293 SF. This 101 SF difference affects required open space amounts (4,709.62 SF vs. 4,715 SF). Verify controlling site area against legal description and survey; if 94,293 SF is correct, recalculate requirements accordingly.

details.text: Sheet 9 Site Plan and Data Table show 4,710 SF; Sheet 35 Landscape Calculations show 5,855 SF—a 1,145 SF discrepancy inconsistent across all sheets.

runComments.comment: Open space square footage inconsistency between plans: Site Plan drawing shows 4,960 SF; Site Data Table shows 4,710 SF provided; Landscape Calculations show 5,859 SF provided. These differences (up to 1,149 SF) represent significant inconsistencies. Reconcile all figures, confirm controlling calculation basis, and ensure all sheets reference the same final open space area.

Square footage for common open space shown on plans is inconsistent. Sheet 9 (Site Plan) shows 4,710 sf provided, but Sheet 35 (Landscape Calculations) shows 5,855 sf provided. This 1,145 sf discrepancy must be resolved with consistent documentation across all plan sheets.

Open space square footage shown on plans does not match square footage in site data table. Sheet 9 Site Data Table shows 'Common Open Space provided: 4710 sf'; Sheet 9 site plan drawing label shows 'Common Open Space 4,990 sf'; Sheet 35 Landscape Calculations shows 'Private Common Open Space Provided: 5,855 sf.' These three conflicting values (4,710, 4,990, and 5,855 sf) create inconsistency between graphic and tabular data that prevents verification of compliance.

details.text: Open space percentages inconsistent between sheets: Sheet 9 shows 5.0% (4,710 SF of 94,192 SF); Sheet 35 shows 6.21% (5,855 SF of 94,293 SF). Percentage difference cascades from conflicting site area and square footage bases.

runComments.comment: Open space percentages and square footages inconsistent across sheets. Site Plan shows 4,960 SF/5%; Site Data Table shows 4,710 SF/5%; Landscape Calculations show 5,859 SF/6.21%. Landscape Plan does not label open space with H.5. Reconcile all sheets to ensure consistent percentages and square footages.

Open space percentages and delineation are inconsistent across plan sheets. Sheet 9 shows 4,710 sf (5.0% of site area); Sheet 35 shows 5,855 sf (6.2% of site area); Sheet 31 landscape plan does not delineate the open space at all despite being identified in the legend. All sheets must show consistent square footage and graphically represent the same open space area.

Open space percentages inconsistent between plan sheets. Sheet 35 Landscape Calculations states: 'Private Common Open Space - Required: 4,715 sf (5% x 94,293); Provided: 5,855 sf' = 6.21% of 94,203 sf. Sheet 9 Site Data Table shows required 4,709.62 sf and provided 4,710 sf = 5.0% of 94,192 sf. The percentage difference (6.21% vs 5.0%) and conflicting site area values (94,293, 94,203, and 94,192 sf) demonstrate inconsistency that must be resolved.

details.text: Site Data Table on Sheet 9 shows open space only as square footage (4,710 SF) without percentage calculation. The percentage of site area must be displayed for compliance verification.

runComments.comment: Open space not shown as a percentage of the applicable site area in site data table. Sheet 9 Site Data Table shows 'Common Open Space provided: 4710' in square feet only, with no percentage calculation shown. The percentage (5% of gross site area) must be displayed in the site data table for verification of compliance.

comments.headline: Open space dimensions not provided on plans
comments.summary: The site and landscape plans do not show width and depth dimensions required to verify that open space meets minimum 20 ft dimensions and 650 SF area requirements.
comments.attn: Add dimension callouts showing length and width to verify 20 ft minimum dimension and 650 SF minimum area compliance.

details.text: Open space labeled only with total square footage (4,710–4,990 SF) without width, depth, and length dimension callouts. Both linear dimensions required to verify minimum 20 ft dimensions for plazas and landscaped areas.

runComments.comment: Open space area not dimensioned on site plan. Width, depth, and total area must be shown. Currently only area label is provided with no width or depth dimensions. Add dimension callouts showing length and width (minimum 20 ft each for landscaped area) to verify compliance.

Open space area is labeled with total square footage (4,710 sf) but specific width, depth, and length dimensions are not provided. Only total area is dimensioned; individual linear dimensions must be shown for the open space boundaries.

Open space areas not dimensioned on site plan. Width, depth, and total area must be shown for each open space area per the code. Sheet 9 provides only a total area label (4,990 sf) without linear dimension lines showing width and depth. Sheet 31 landscape plan provides no dimensions for the central courtyard/open space area. The minimum 20 ft dimension requirement for plazas and landscaped areas cannot be verified.

details.text: Minimum 20 ft dimension and 650 SF requirements cannot be verified. Site plan shows 4,710–4,960 SF but provides no width or depth dimension callouts on site or landscape plans.

runComments.comment: Compliance with minimum 20 ft dimension and 650 SF area requirements cannot be verified. Site plan shows 4,960 SF (exceeds 650 SF) but provides no width or depth dimensions. Without specific dimension callouts showing both width and depth meet 20 ft minimum, compliance cannot be confirmed. Add dimension callouts to site plan.

Cannot verify whether open space meets Subchapter E minimum dimensional requirements (20 ft minimum width and depth, 650 SF minimum area) because the specific width and depth dimensions are not provided on the site plan. If the open space is claimed as a plaza or landscaped area type, these dimensions must be verified; currently only the total area (4,710 sf) is dimensioned.

Open space designated as plaza or landscaped area does not meet Subchapter E minimum dimensional requirements (20 ft minimum width and depth, 650 SF minimum area). Cannot be verified because neither width nor depth dimensions are provided on the plans. Without these linear dimensions, compliance with the 20 ft minimum dimension requirement cannot be confirmed, and the total area of 4,710-5,855 sf is ambiguous given the conflicting values.

comments.headline: Open space type not identified

comments.attn: Identify which permitted type per § 2.7.3.A: natural/undeveloped, landscaped area, plaza/patio, play area, educational/sensory feature, swimming pool, pond, trail, sports court, transit plaza, or combination.

details.text: Open space not identified by type on site plan. Code allows 11 types: natural/undeveloped, landscaped area, plaza/patio with seating, play area, educational/cultural/sensory feature, swimming pool, water quality pond, multi-use trail, sports court, transit plaza, or combination. Type must be specified.

runComments.comment: Type of open space not identified on site plan. Labeled only as 'Common Open Space 4,960 sf' without specifying which of 11 permitted types: natural/undeveloped, landscaped area, plaza/patio, play area, educational/cultural/sensory feature, swimming pool, pond, trail, sports court, transit plaza, or combination. Identify specific type(s) claimed per LDC § 2.7.3.A.

Type of open space is not identified on site plan. The area is labeled 'Common Open Space' but does not identify which of the 11 permitted types it represents: (1) natural and undeveloped, (2) landscaped area, (3) plaza or patio with outdoor seating, (4) play area, (5) educational/cultural/sensory feature, (6) swimming pool, (7) water quality/detention pond, (8) multi-use trail, (9) sports court, (10) transit plaza, or (11) combination. Explicit type designation is required.

Type of open space not identified on site plan. Plans do not identify which of the 11 permitted open space types under § 2.7.3.A is being claimed: (1) natural and undeveloped area, (2) landscaped area, (3) plaza or patio with outdoor seating, (4) play area, (5) educational/cultural/sensory feature, (6) swimming pool, (7) water quality/stormwater pond, (8) multi-use trail, (9) sports court, (10) transit plaza, or (11) combination. This identification is required to verify compliance with type-specific requirements.

details.text: Site plan open space label reads "Common Open Space 4,960 sf" without specifying which of the 11 permitted types applies. Type identification is required per LDC § 2.7.3.A.

runComments.comment: Open space area not labeled with type. Site plan shows only 'Common Open Space 4,960 sf' without specifying which of the 11 permitted types applies (landscaped area, plaza, play area, etc.). Revise label to include specific open space type per LDC § 2.7.3.A.

comments.headline: Open space not delineated on landscape plan
comments.summary: Landscape plan legend defines H.5 "Private Common Open Space" hatch pattern but does not apply this pattern to any open space area on the actual drawing.
comments.attn: Apply H.5 hatch pattern to all open space areas on landscape plan to match site plan delineation.

details.text: H.5 "Private Common Open Space" hatch pattern defined in Key Notes legend on Sheet 31 but not applied anywhere on the actual landscape plan drawing. Open space boundary must be delineated with this pattern to match site plan.

runComments.comment: Open space areas not delineated on landscape plan with H.5 legend label. Legend defines H.5 but does not apply marker to open space boundary. Apply H.5 legend marker and hatching/shading to all areas comprising the required open space on landscape plan.

The H.5 'Private Common Open Space' hatch pattern is defined in the Key Notes legend on Sheet 31 but is not applied to any area on the actual landscape plan drawing. The open space must be delineated with the appropriate hatch pattern or legend label to match the site plan delineation.

Open space areas not delineated on landscape plan with shading or legend label. The legend identifies 'PRIVATE COMMON OPEN SPACE' (Key Note H.5) with a specific hatching pattern (horizontal lines), but this pattern does not appear anywhere on the landscape plan drawing. The central courtyard area between buildings and other open areas are not visually identified as private common open space on the landscape plan.

details.text: Open space areas not graphically delineated on landscape plan using H.5 hatching. Legend specifies horizontal line pattern; this pattern does not appear on drawing. Central courtyard and other open areas lack visual identification.

runComments.comment: Open space areas not graphically delineated on landscape plan using H.5 hatching. Legend defines H.5 as Private Common Open Space with grid/square hatch pattern but this pattern is not applied to any areas on the actual drawing. Hatch the required minimum open space with H.5 pattern on landscape plan.

Open space areas not graphically delineated on landscape plan using the H.5 (PRIVATE COMMON OPEN SPACE) hatching pattern specified in the legend. While Sheet 9 labels a central courtyard as 'Common Open Space 4,990 sf,' the landscape plan (Sheet 31) contains no H.5 hatch pattern delineation anywhere, and the central courtyard area between buildings is not marked with any pattern distinguishing it as private common open space.

comments.headline: Open space amenities not identified on plans
comments.summary: Specific amenities (seating, shade structures, pathways, play equipment) are not identified or labeled within the designated open space area on either site plan or landscape plan.
comments.attn: Identify and label all amenities (seating, shade structures, paths, plantings) within open space to demonstrate functional design per claimed type.

details.text: Specific amenities within open space not clearly identified or labeled on site or landscape plans. While central courtyard is labeled, no seating, tables, play equipment, shade structures, or recreational amenities are shown.

runComments.comment: Specific amenities within open space areas not clearly identified and described. Landscape plan shows flagstone/cobblestone pattern and trees within courtyard but no callouts or legend labels identify specific amenities (seating, paths, plantings, etc.). Identify and label all amenities included within the open space on site and landscape plans.

Specific amenities provided within open space areas not identified and described on site plan or landscape plan. While the central courtyard area is labeled on Sheet 9, no amenities are identified within the open space area. Vision analysis of the landscape plan (Sheet 31) confirms that no seating areas, tables, play equipment, shade structures, or other recreational amenities are shown or labeled within the open space. Only decomposed granite walkways and utility lines are noted.

details.text: Pedestrian amenities required for plaza or landscaped area types not identified and shown. If claimed as plaza/landscaped type, seating, shade structures, pathways must be delineated and labeled on landscape plan.

runComments.comment: Pedestrian amenities are not identified or shown within the open space areas. The site plan shows only tree symbols and hatching within the central open space courtyard, with no labeled seating, benches, tables, gathering areas, shade structures, or other pedestrian amenities. Required amenities must be identified and depicted on both site plan and landscape plan sheets.

Pedestrian amenities required within open space areas not identified and shown on plans. If the open space is claimed as a plaza or landscaped area (types 2 or 3), pedestrian amenities such as seating, shade structures, pathways, or similar features must be shown on the landscape plan. The landscape plan shows only unpatterned areas and utility lines; no specific pedestrian amenities are delineated or labeled.

comments.attn: If claiming landscaped area type, provide calculation showing proposed landscaping in open space exceeds Subchapter C, Article 9 minimums.

runComments.comment: Landscaped area claimed as open space not demonstrated to exceed the minimum landscaping required by Subchapter C, Article 9. Landscape plans and calculations do not show a breakdown comparing the proposed landscape area within the open space against the minimum landscaping requirements for the site. Cannot verify that landscape area in the open space exceeds the minimum required landscaping by Subchapter C Article 9.

Cannot confirm designated open space falls outside this exclusion zone. Add street yard boundary delineation to site plan.
